# HexPiece 3.7.7

The phoenix's M1 is a flamethrower. **Not tested in game yet:** the build and all 13 test suites pass, and everything here was
rendered and checked in previews.

## Transformed M1: the phoenix's flamethrower
"Transformed M1, shall make the bird open it's beak and act as a flamethrower (blasting flames at the target like the dragon does)."
- **Hold M1 as the phoenix** and its beak opens: the lower half of the beak swings down at the corners of the mouth (your model had
  no jaw, so the beak is split along its own mouth line when it loads; your file is not changed).
- **The flame:** a white-hot jet rushes out from between the open jaws and blooms into a stream of blue fire (a few gold flames in
  it), widening into a wall of fire at its end, with white shock rings racing out along it and a soft blue glow. It goes where you aim
  (onto your crosshair), bends as you turn, and stops at a wall. Built the same way as the dragon's fire breath, in the phoenix's colours.
- **The pose:** while it breathes, the phoenix rears back a little against the blast, thrusts its neck out and aims its head down
  your look; its wings hold wide and beat short to keep it in the air. Let go and the flame dies off, the beak shuts and the head
  goes back to normal.
- **What it does:** 24 blocks of fire; every quarter second everyone in the cone is burnt and set on fire. It lasts as long as you hold
  M1 (up to 5 seconds), then has a 4 second cooldown. With the Conqueror's Haki and Ryou on, the Conqueror's lightning comes off
  whoever it burns (or where it hits a wall).
- **Sound:** the dragon breath's fire roar, pitched a little higher.
- As the phoenix, M1 never punches or breaks blocks any more; the human's M1 is unchanged. The phoenix's move list shows
  "Phoenix: Flamethrower [LMB] hold".
- In first person (the phoenix isn't drawn there) the flame comes from just under the middle of your view.
